import struct
ISO="/app/alpine.iso"

def read_sector(f,lba,count=1):
    f.seek(lba*2048)
    return f.read(2048*count)
def parse_dir(f,lba,length,cb):
    sectors=(length+2047)//2048
    f.seek(lba*2048)
    data=f.read(sectors*2048)
    off=0
    n=len(data)
    while off<n:
        rec_len=data[off]
        if rec_len==0:
            off=(off//2048+1)*2048
            if off>=n: break
            continue
        if off+rec_len>n: break
        flags=data[off+25]
        loc=struct.unpack_from("<I",data,off+2)[0]
        dlen=struct.unpack_from("<I",data,off+10)[0]
        name_len=data[off+32]
        name=data[off+33:off+33+name_len]
        nm=name.split(b";")[0].decode("latin1")
        is_dir=bool(flags & 2)
        cb(nm,is_dir,loc,dlen)
        off+=rec_len
def find(f,parts):
    parts=[p.upper() for p in parts]
    pvd=read_sector(f,16)
    cur_loc=struct.unpack_from("<I",pvd,156+2)[0]
    cur_len=struct.unpack_from("<I",pvd,156+10)[0]
    for i,part in enumerate(parts):
        found=[None]
        def cb(nm,is_dir,loc,dlen):
            if nm.upper()==part:
                found[0]=(nm,is_dir,loc,dlen)
        parse_dir(f,cur_loc,cur_len,cb)
        if not found[0]:
            raise SystemExit("NOT FOUND: "+part)
        nm,is_dir,loc,dlen=found[0]
        if i==len(parts)-1:
            return loc,dlen
        if not is_dir:
            raise SystemExit("NOT DIR: "+part)
        cur_loc=loc; cur_len=dlen
def extract(f,parts,outp):
    loc,dlen=find(f,parts)
    f.seek(loc*2048)
    data=f.read(dlen)
    with open(outp,"wb") as o:
        o.write(data)
    print("extracted", "/".join(parts), len(data), "->", outp)
with open(ISO,"rb") as f:
    extract(f,["boot","vmlinuz-lts"],OUT+"/vmlinuz-lts")
    extract(f,["boot","initramfs-lts"],OUT+"/initramfs-lts")
PYEOF
